kinetic.boundary_contribution: GHY+B1 derivative terms under x-dependent endpoint/metric variation
kinetic.constraint_correction: lapse/shift Schur complement after radial gauge removal
kinetic.endpoint_contribution: transversality contribution for the moving endpoint representation
kinetic.gravity_raw: P1 kinetic form on delta a and the four-dimensional metric representative carrying delta X
kinetic.known_zero: Z_partial does not contribute: sigma_partial is a distinct B1 field and no action/domain map identifies it with q
kinetic.metric: ds5^2=N^2 d rho^2+a^2 h_mu_nu dx^mu dx^nu
kinetic.normalization: integral a_0^4 u_1^2 d rho=1 per cap
kinetic.two_cap_scalar_formula: k_q^scalar=2 Z5 integral_0^rhoJ N a^2 (partial_q sigma)^2 d rho
